llm.summary: This Etsy category lookup skill also includes account login, API-key generation, and payment-order flows that users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: The category script sends search parameters, API key, and session metadata to a LinkFox gateway, and both category and onboarding scripts allow gateway/login endpoints to be overridden by environment variables. Network use is disclosed for the API-backed tool, but env-overridable authenticated endpoints are broader than needed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No automatic installer, background service, or package-install hook was found. The scripts are invoked manually by command and optional dependencies are only requested when QR rendering is used.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger text activates broadly on Etsy category queries, while the onboarding instructions can lead the agent into credential and billing workflows after auth or balance errors. The onboarding path is documented, but the broad trigger plus sensitive follow-on actions creates under-scoped activation risk.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The category script writes cached and full response JSON under linkfox session/cache directories, the onboarding script may write payment QR PNGs, and login prints the retrieved API key in stdout JSON for later shell configuration. These are disclosed in scripts or onboarding docs, but they retain sensitive operational data without strong retention or redaction controls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core category-search behavior is coherent with a LinkFox API-backed Etsy taxonomy lookup, but the artifact also ships phone/SMS login, API-token generation, package listing, order creation, payment QR rendering, and order status features. Those support auth/billing recovery, but they are high-impact capabilities for a skill primarily presented as category lookup.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting this skill contact LinkFox services, use a LinkFox API key, and guide users through phone-based login or payment flows when auth or billing errors occur. Treat any SMS code and returned API key as sensitive, avoid endpoint override environment variables unless you control them, and review generated linkfox cache/session files for retained data.
llm.findings:
[TT3] unexpected: Verified authenticated network calls use API keys, login tokens, phone/code data, and env-derived base URLs. Gateway access is expected for LinkFox, but arbitrary environment endpoint overrides for authenticated requests are not well-contained.
[TP4] unexpected: Verified the skill is named and described as Etsy category search while shipped instructions and code also cover account onboarding and payments. This is disclosed in SKILL.md, so it is not hidden, but it materially broadens the skill's authority.
[SDI-1] expected: Verified the category script writes full responses and cache files. Persisting category lookup results is described in the script, but main skill documentation gives limited retention guidance and the code can fall back outside the current working directory.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified onboarding.py implements account, package, order, and payment API routines. These are documented as auth/billing remediation, but they are broader than the advertised lookup purpose.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified SMS login, token exchange, API-key retrieval/generation, plan listing, payment order creation, and QR generation. These require user-supplied inputs and are not automatically executed, but they are high-impact support workflows for a lookup skill.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Verified the category script header says output is forbidden from /tmp and current-directory failure should error, while the implementation can fall back to home or temporary linkfox directories.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Verified trigger text tells the agent to activate on broad Etsy category-related requests even without the tool name; this is risky because the same skill contains auth and billing remediation paths.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Verified onboarding instructions process phone numbers and SMS codes, and login returns an API key on stdout. The flow is documented, but privacy, redaction, and retention safeguards are minimal.
